verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents automations in the form of Agent Flows and custom agent skills, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. The dated changelogs and /v1 API path-versioning describe app and API releases, not user automation history, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
